semantic_candidates.evidence: Two disjoint cylinders normal to the plate caps overcut both z faces by 5 millimetres. Two exact cylindrical walls and two closed inner loops on each cap establish two through-holes rather than blind pockets or one merged opening.

validation_findings.evidence: All rectangular plate edges, circular rim edges, and axial seam edges have positive analytic extent.
Every imported edge retains an exact Geom_Line or Geom_Circle representation.
Each of the two full-periodic cylindrical hole walls has one unique axial seam edge with two oriented face occurrences.
The no-processing STEP readback records 1e-7 millimetres, equal to 1e-10 metres, for every vertex, edge, and face tolerance.
All eighteen unique edges have exactly two face uses; four circular cap loops close against the two cylindrical walls and both outer cap loops close against the four side faces.
The radius-3 and radius-4 holes are separated by more than their radius sum and stay clear of the plate boundary, so the sole shell has no tangent contacts or non-manifold edge.
Both holes span the full 8 millimetre thickness, remain mutually disjoint and inside the positive-thickness plate, and the processing-disabled readback is B-rep valid.

oracle.statement: A 42 by 30 by 8 millimetre box is cut by radius-3 and radius-4 cylinders centred at (12,14) and (27,15), each extending from z=-5 to z=13. Their centre separation is sqrt(226) millimetres, greater than the 7 millimetre radius sum, and both remain inside the plate outline. The result has one closed outer shell with four rectangular side faces, two multiply perforated planar caps, and two inward-facing cylindrical walls: eight faces and twelve face-bound wires. Twelve box edges, four circular rim edges, and two cylindrical seams give eighteen unique edges; the eight box corners and four seam endpoints give twelve unique vertices. Two face uses per edge produce thirty-six edge occurrences and seventy-two endpoint occurrences.
